SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   C. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

9. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   B. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

7. A — Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. (4 marks)
